items.title: 10.17.3 E standard qeematon se oxidising aur reducing agents (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.17.3, printed pages 233-234.

blocks.text: Reduction half-equations ki fehrist mein, jaise E standard zyada manfi hota hai, baen taraf ki species kamzor oxidising agents banti hain (woh electrons kam aasani se qubool karti hain) aur daen taraf ki species taqatwar reducing agents (woh electrons zyada aasani se chhorti hain). Copper Zn2+ ions ko Zn mein reduce nahi karega; Zn2+ ions reduce karne ke liye taqatwar reducing agent chahiye, jis ka E standard Zn2+/Zn se zyada manfi ho. Half-equation Mg2+/Mg ki qeemat zyada manfi hai, to magnesium munasib reducing agent hai: Zn2+ + 2e- se Zn, -0.76 V (print 'e-' likhti hai), aur Mg2+ + 2e- se Mg, -2.38 V. Zn2+ behtar oxidising agent hai, Mg2+ se zyada electrons qubool karne ka imkan rakhta hai; Mg behtar reducing agent hai, Zn se zyada electrons chhorne ka imkan rakhta hai.

Compounds bhi oxidising aur reducing agents ka kaam karte hain: KMnO4 (print +0.54 V) aur K2Cr2O7 (+1.33 V) apni oonchi E standard qeematon ki wajah se oxidising agents hain, jabke KI aur FeSO4 apni kam qeematon ki wajah se reducing agents. H2O2 jaise chand compounds oxidising aur reducing dono agents ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: E standard Ag+/Ag +0.80 V, Cr2+/Cr -0.91 V aur Fe2+/Fe -0.44 V ke saath, kaun sa ion sab se taqatwar oxidising agent hai aur kaun sa sab se kam, aur Ag, Cr aur Fe ko barhti reducing taqat mein tarteeb dein (Quick Check 10.6b, 10.9c).
blocks.explanation: Ag+ ki qeemat sab se musbat hai, to woh sab se taqatwar oxidising agent hai; Cr2+ ki sab se manfi, to woh sab se kam oxidising hai. Reducing taqat E standard ke zyada manfi hone ke saath barhti hai: Ag (sab se kamzor) < Fe < Cr (sab se taqatwar).

items: Zyada manfi E standard: baen kamzor oxidising agent, daen taqatwar reducing agent. Mg (-2.38 V) Zn2+ (-0.76 V) ko reduce karta hai; Cu nahi kar sakta. KMnO4 aur K2Cr2O7 (+1.33 V) oxidise karte hain; KI aur FeSO4 reduce; H2O2 dono.
